kpi_definitions.activation: A user's first successful report export within seven days of signup.
kpi_definitions.paid_conversion: A payment-processor-confirmed first invoice with a stable transaction identifier.
kpi_definitions.signup: Backend-confirmed account creation, never a button click or page view.

privacy_and_quality_constraints: Analytics tags may fire only when analytics_storage is granted.
Email addresses, full names, phone numbers, and free-text form content must not be sent to GA4.
Internal traffic is excluded from launch QA metrics.
Campaign values are normalized before collection; raw query strings are not analytics properties.
System-event retries and success-page reloads must not inflate conversions.
